origin.description: Strip the indent glue removes from a multiline template.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: One string, or a vector of strings.

origin.details: Leading space on the first line is removed. Later lines lose the shortest indent of the non-blank lines. A trailing newline is removed. textwrap.dedent does not follow the first-line rule or the backslash continuation.
origin.example:
cat(trim("
    A formatted string
    Can have multiple lines
      with additional indentation preserved
    "), "
", sep = "")

translation.description: The same indent rules, including a backslash at the end of a line.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: One string, or a vector of strings.

translation.details: A string with no newline is returned unchanged. The indent is counted in spaces and tabs.
translation.value: The trimmed string, or a Glue vector when the input is a list.
translation.example:
from glue import trim
print(trim("
    A formatted string
    Can have multiple lines
      with additional indentation preserved
    "))
